goodToKnow: Die Selbstjustiz is vigilante justice, taking the law into one's own hands: Selbstjustiz üben. In a Rechtsstaat, punishment belongs to the courts, and the state holds the monopoly on force, so Selbstjustiz is itself a crime. Legitimate self-defence against an attack is die Notwehr (§32 StGB). Die Justiz means the judiciary. It has no plural.
